name: Assert
description: Run real Playwright E2E tests from your AI coding agent. Point the MCP server at your repo's assert.config.json, then generate scenarios, run tests, and inspect results from chat.

ASSERT_CONFIG.description: Path to your repo's assert.config.json or a project directory containing it.

ASSERT_API_KEY.description: Optional override if you do not store a project key in assert.config.json.
